page_title: TOR 1-0 NAP | Torino v Napoli 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Matteo Marcenaro has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The goal by Napoli is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
90+6' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Napoli players aren’t happy.
90+4' Goal! Noa Lang (Napoli) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
90+3' Noa Lang (Napoli) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+2' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Franco Israel easily deals with the threat.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Foul! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Torino will take a free kick.
89' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
86' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a long ball in, but Franco Israel comfortably gathers the ball.
84' Kristjan Asllani goes off the pitch and Ardian Ismajli (Torino) comes on.
84' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Duvan Zapata (Torino) replacing Che Adams.
83' Noa Lang (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Franco Israel, who smothers the ball.
82' That's the end of the game for Billy Gilmour, who is replaced by Eljif Elmas (Napoli).
81' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
81' Matteo Politano (Napoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
81' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marcenaro signals a set piece. Napoli have a free kick.
80' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Noa Lang (Napoli), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
77' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

77' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nikola Vlasic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
75' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Niels Nkounkou and he is replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino).
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Matteo Politano (Napoli) is replacing David Neres.
74' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca is replaced by Giuseppe Ambrosino (Napoli).
73' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
70' David Neres (Napoli) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
68' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
65' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) coming on for Juan Jesus.
63' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Noa Lang (Napoli) replaces Mathias Olivera.
62' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giovanni Simeone.
61' The resulting corner from David Neres (Napoli) is cleared.

61' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Franco Israel, who pulls off a stunning save! Napoli have a corner.
60' David Neres (Napoli) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
60' A cross into the box from David Neres (Napoli) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
57' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a free kick to Torino, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
54' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off the line to clear the ball away.

52' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Franco Israel easily catches the ball.
51' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle. Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Torino.
51' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Billy Gilmour (Napoli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
50' The referee awards a corner and Kristjan Asllani (Torino) goes over to take it.

49' Che Adams (Torino) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' The yellow card goes to Franco Israel (Torino).
47' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Frank Anguissa (Napoli) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
47' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' David Neres (Napoli) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
45+1' Cesare Casadei (Torino) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli win a free kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.

41' What a miss! Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
40' Sam Beukema (Napoli) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
40' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
39' Matteo Marcenaro blows the whistle, Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Torino have been awarded a free kick.
38' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
37' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) sends the corner into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts it and averts the threat.
37' Che Adams (Torino) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Torino will take a corner kick.

35' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
34' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
32' 1 - 0 Giovanni Simeone (Torino) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Vanja Milinkovic-Savic with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
31' Franco Israel is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Billy Gilmour (Napoli). Easy save!
30' The resulting corner from David Neres (Napoli) comes to nothing.
28' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.

27' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Neres (Napoli).
25' Niels Nkounkou (Torino) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
24' David Neres (Napoli) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

23' That was close by Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
23' David Neres (Napoli) sends a long ball in, but Franco Israel comfortably gathers the ball.
22' A cross from Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
21' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
20' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
18' David Neres (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

17' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Franco Israel tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
16' Adrien Tameze (Torino) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matteo Marcenaro signals. A free kick to Napoli.
15' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
14' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
12' Napoli take a short corner kick.
12' A raking crossfield pass from Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
11' Niels Nkounkou (Torino) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
10' Juan Jesus (Napoli) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
10' Juan Jesus (Napoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for an infringement.
9' David Neres (Napoli) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

7' Niels Nkounkou (Torino) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
5' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle after Giovanni Simeone (Torino) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Napoli will kick the game off.
Matteo Marcenaro will officiate today.
